name: Dialog
purpose: Modal card with a badge, a headline, optional detail copy, an optional field slot and an action row that holds the accept action. One widget covers both sheet-card rows: kind name (new-list, new-project, rename-list) and kind confirm (delete-list, delete-confirm). Named Dialog rather than SheetCard, because shadcn's Sheet is a side panel (see open, item 6). Measured: width min(26rem,100%) (364px at the 14px root), radius 0.75rem (10.5px), background oklch(0.995 0.001 255), elevation menu, surface 2, overflow hidden. Folded: the background into the card surface token, the menu elevation and surface 2 into the menu elevation, and animate-sheet-in into the standard open motion. Heights of 141px (name) and 122px (confirm) differ with content, so there is no height axis. Padding is an estimate only (about 15px top and left, 10px sides and bottom). Also (structure): Modal card for a prompt (rename, new list), a delete confirmation, and the palette and fullscreen sizes that CommandPalette and Lightbox render. On web it sits over a Scrim; on desktop each one is its own window.
base: Radix Dialog (Title, Description and Content), placed inside the single Radix Dialog root owned by Overlay; styled as shadcn DialogContent. It does not create a second Radix Dialog root.

values.when: Body is a text field and focus goes to the field (initial focus is the field here; the catalogue says field or accept button, proposed). Used by new-list, new-project and rename-list. Accept button is the primary action, in accent blue.

Body is optional detail copy and focus goes to the accept button (catalogue). Detail appears only when present (conditional, not a separate state). Used by delete-list and delete-confirm. Accept button uses the danger colour (inferred).
Name sheets (new list, rename). Role dialog. Footer buttons at y 413 in the recorded name sheets. Accept in the default tone.
Web: centred over the window with a Scrim.
Desktop: its own window; no scrim; the main window is not dimmed (decision).
490px wide, top at y 91, max height 60vh, surface-2 with menu elevation. Anchored at the top (CommandPalette).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the card requests a close. Escape and outside-click wiring is not recorded for these cards (see open).

props.name: kind
props.description: Selects the body and the initial focus target.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour of the accept button. Defaults from kind (name gives default, confirm gives destructive). Inferred: the catalogue does not record the accept colour.

props.name: badge
props.description: Badge slot at the top of the card (catalogue: both sheet cards hold a badge).

props.name: title
props.description: Headline, rendered as Dialog.Title so it labels the dialog through aria-labelledby.

props.name: description
props.description: Detail copy, rendered as Dialog.Description. aria-describedby is set only when present.

props.name: children
props.description: Body slot. For kind name this holds the text field; omitted for kind confirm.

props.name: onAccept
props.description: Runs the accept action. The action row holds only the accept button; no cancel prop, because the row's other contents are not recorded.

props.name: presentation
props.description: Overlay on web, separate window on desktop.

props.name: footer
props.description: A Footer row with the actions (Cancel and accept).

role: dialog with aria-modal=true (as recorded). aria-labelledby points at the title; aria-describedby points at the description only when it is set. Open question whether confirm should use alertdialog.
keyboard: Initial focus is the field (kind name) or the accept button (kind confirm), as recorded. Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside the card (Radix modal focus trap, proposed). Enter activates the focused accept button. Clicks inside do nothing. Escape and outside-click dismissal are not recorded for either kind (see open). On close, focus returns to the opener (Radix default, to verify). / Escape closes (captureEscape). Tab and Shift+Tab are trapped inside (trapFocus). Initial focus on the first field is proposed. Enter activates accept only if set as the default (not in catalogue). Focus return to the opener is not recorded.
platform: Differs. Web: a modal card over the page, inside Overlay with placement center; a dim scrim is assumed, not recorded. Desktop: each card opens as its own window whose content is this card, with the title as the window title (suggested). No scrim, so the main window is never dimmed and an outside click does nothing to it. Window chrome supplies the close control. The separate-window rule is not in overlays.json (assumption). Window size and chrome are not decided. / Desktop: presentation window; each sheet is its own window with no Scrim; close by Escape or the close control; no outside-press dismissal for a window. Web: overlay with a Scrim; outside press dismisses; focus trapped.
open: 1) Accept colour is not recorded. Tone is inferred from kind and the danger rule, which is not in overlays.json. Tone is a prop that defaults from kind, not a variant axis: A's tone axis and B's intent axis both duplicated kind. An explicit override is held back until a non-destructive confirm is recorded. 2) Role: the catalogue records dialog for both kinds; shadcn AlertDialog uses alertdialog for destructive confirms. Decide whether confirm changes role. 3) Initial focus: the catalogue puts focus on the accept button of confirm cards, so Enter deletes on open. Decide whether Cancel takes focus instead; cancel is not recorded. B's initialFocus prop was dropped, since kind sets focus. 4) Dismissal: Escape and outside-click are not recorded for either kind; Radix defaults would close them. Decide. 5) Source conflict on the name card: its text field says 'No visible text.' while its purpose says the card holds a badge and text. The headline is treated as visible text here; unresolved. 6) Naming and kind: A named this SheetCard to keep it apart from shadcn Sheet; this design uses Dialog. The catalogue kinds array lists 'sheet' (overlays.json line 5) but no row uses it, and both cards are tagged dialog. Decide whether kind 'sheet' is kept (retag the rows) or dropped; the name is open if the team wants the catalogue term. 7) The catalogue component for both cards is Surface (rendered as Surface2). It is treated here as this card's surface token and menu elevation, not a separate primitive; confirm whether Surface is a primitive to reuse. 8) Padding is estimated only; measure before setting spacing tokens. 9) The action row is accept-only. B's actions ReactNode was dropped. 10) Confirm with a description is a conditional, not a state (A's note); B's separate state entry was dropped. 11) Window size and chrome are not decided on desktop. / The reference runs one destructive confirm in place (reset all settings button, ConfirmButton). The decision makes confirmations windows on desktop, so ConfirmButton may be replaced by Dialog kind confirm (undecided). B's kind sheet is named prompt here. Dropped duplicates: B's command palette panel is CommandPalette; A's sheet action row is Footer. The outside-press path and focus return are not confirmed (Overlay source not read). Palette and lightbox desktop presentation are undecided.
